one_line: SpreadsheetBench 2 evaluates agents on end-to-end business spreadsheet workflows.
SpreadsheetBench 2 用 321 个端到端业务电子表格工作流评测智能体。
why: it extends spreadsheet agents to end-to-end business workflows

title: Problem
问题
html:
SpreadsheetBench 2 asks whether spreadsheet agents can complete end-to-end business workflows, not isolated spreadsheet edits. The primary source is the arXiv paper https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29955, submitted on 2026-06-29; the official project page, GitHub repository, and Hugging Face dataset provide the public artifacts. No conference or journal acceptance is confirmed from the primary sources as of 2026-07-17.

The decision boundary is both an agent environment surface and a benchmark surface. Each instance is a business workflow instruction, an input workbook, a gold workbook, and an evaluation contract over modified cells or visualization checklists. It is not a general office benchmark, a spreadsheet QA dataset, or a disclosed training recipe. It belongs in the atlas because it extends spreadsheet reasoning from single-step workbook edits to multi-sheet, domain-heavy, file-state workflows with executable or rubric-grounded feedback.

SpreadsheetBench 2 问的是：spreadsheet agent 能否完成端到端业务电子表格工作流，而不是只做孤立单元格编辑。主来源是 2026-06-29 提交的 arXiv 论文 https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29955；官方项目页、GitHub 仓库和 Hugging Face 数据集提供公开 artifact。截至 2026-07-17，一手来源未确认会议或期刊接收，应写作 arXiv preprint / venue unknown。

它同时属于 agent environment surface 和 benchmark surface。一个 instance 包含业务 workflow instruction、输入 workbook、gold workbook，以及针对 modified cells 或 visualization checklist 的评测契约。它不是通用办公 benchmark，不是 spreadsheet QA，也不是训练配方；它的价值在于把 spreadsheet reasoning 从单步文件编辑推进到多 sheet、强领域依赖、需要最终文件状态验收的业务工作流。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is a 321-task benchmark for realistic business spreadsheet workflows. SpreadsheetBench 2 moves beyond forum-derived manipulation instructions by asking agents to construct, debug, template, or visualize business workbooks that may require many sheets, long instructions, and hundreds of cell edits.

The data object is a workflow task directory containing dataset.json records and spreadsheet files for four categories: Financial Modeling, Debugging, Template, and Visualization. The feedback contract is mixed. Financial Modeling, Template, and Debugging compare the produced workbook against the gold workbook with cell-level modification scores and task-level accuracy. Visualization uses expert-designed checklist items judged by a VLM, reported as pass rates for data correctness and format compliance. The closest comparisons are SpreadsheetBench 2024, Office/desktop agent benchmarks, and SWE-agent-style environment harnesses. The direction label is business spreadsheet workflow evaluation with file-state and checklist feedback.

核心贡献是一个包含 321 个任务的真实业务 spreadsheet workflow benchmark。它不是继续做论坛式短操作，而是要求 agent 构建、调试、套模板或可视化业务 workbook，任务可能包含许多 sheet、很长 instruction 和数百个需要修改的 cell。

数据对象是按任务目录组织的 dataset.json 记录和 spreadsheet 文件，覆盖 Financial Modeling、Debugging、Template、Visualization 四类。反馈契约是混合的：Financial Modeling / Template / Debugging 用输出 workbook 和 gold workbook 比较，给 modified-cell 分数和 task-level accuracy；Visualization 用专家设计 checklist，再由 VLM 判断 Data Correctness 和 Format Compliance。最接近的对比对象是 SpreadsheetBench 2024、Office/desktop agent benchmark 和 SWE-agent 式环境 harness。方向标签是 business spreadsheet workflow evaluation with file-state and checklist feedback。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs are long natural-language business instructions, input .xlsx workbooks, category metadata, and a scaffolded agent environment. Outputs are submitted workbooks, modified-cell records, task-level accuracy, and visualization checklist judgments.

The benchmark has 321 tasks: 100 Financial Modeling, 100 Debugging, 97 Template, and 24 Visualization tasks. The authors build gold-standard spreadsheets from public business and financial materials, including reports, corporate filings, and named data sources such as NYU Stern Damodaran data, Screener.in, Bloomberg, and Bseindia; then they convert complete workbooks into tasks by removing target regions, injecting controlled errors, or specifying visualization goals. Each task is intended to have a unique answer, self-contained instructions, and standard finance/business-domain assumptions. Two independent experts solve tasks for validation and disagreements trigger revision; the paper reports more than 1,500 expert annotation hours.

Evaluation uses an observe-reason-act scaffold based on SWE-agent. The agent can use bash, a read-only view_xlsx tool, and submit, with a Python 3.11 / Debian Bullseye Docker environment, no network, and up to 50 turns. For workbook tasks, Modification measures target-cell computed-value match rate and Accuracy requires all required modified cells to be correct while preserving cells that should not change. Visualization requires Windows Excel/WPS COM export of chart images and a GLM-4.6V checklist judge. Reproduction must pin the dataset release, code revision, spreadsheet engine, VLM judge/API version, scaffold, turn budget, and unavailable raw-source boundary.

输入包括长自然语言业务 instruction、输入 .xlsx workbook、任务类别 metadata 和 scaffolded agent environment。输出包括提交的 workbook、modified-cell 记录、task-level accuracy，以及 visualization checklist judgment。

benchmark 共 321 题：Financial Modeling 100、Debugging 100、Template 97、Visualization 24。作者基于公开业务和金融材料构建 gold-standard spreadsheets，包括 reports、corporate filings，以及 NYU Stern Damodaran dataset、Screener.in、Bloomberg、Bseindia 等来源；再把完整 workbook 转成任务输入，例如移除目标区域、注入受控错误或指定可视化目标。任务要求答案唯一、instruction 自包含，并只依赖标准金融/业务领域惯例。每题由两名未参与构造的专家独立求解，分歧会触发修订；论文报告专家标注工作量超过 1,500 小时。

评测使用基于 SWE-agent 的 observe-reason-act scaffold。agent 可用 bash、只读 view_xlsx 和 submit，运行在 Python 3.11 / Debian Bullseye Docker、无网络、最多 50 turns。workbook 任务中，Modification 衡量目标 cell computed value 匹配率，Accuracy 要求所有应修改 cell 正确且不应修改 cell 不被破坏。Visualization 需要在 Windows 上通过 Excel/WPS COM 导出 chart image，再由 GLM-4.6V checklist judge 评分。复现必须固定数据 release、代码 revision、spreadsheet 引擎、VLM judge/API 版本、scaffold、turn budget 和不可再分发 raw source 的边界。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The evidence is a public benchmark with difficult workflow-level tasks and low reported model accuracy. The paper reports 321 tasks averaging 11.8 worksheets, 429.0 instruction words, and 593.5 modified cells per task. Financial Modeling is especially large, averaging 15.3 sheets and 1,164.5 modified cells; Debugging averages 21.1 sheets.

In the main results, the highest reported model is Claude Opus 4.6 with 34.89% overall Accuracy and 77.20% overall Modification, while Debugging Accuracy remains 12.00%. Other reported overall Accuracy scores include GPT-5.2 at 26.79%, Gemini 3.1 Pro at 23.68%, GLM-5 at 17.14%, Deepseek-V3.2 at 15.58%, Kimi K2.5 at 14.64%, Qwen3.5-397B-A17B at 11.22%, and MiniMax M2.5 at 7.17%. A scaffold comparison using GLM-5 reports 46.32 Modification / 15.45 Accuracy for the authors' SWE-agent-based scaffold, versus 43.47 / 14.20 for Claude Code. Spreadsheet products are evaluated only on a 30-example subset and should not be compared as full-benchmark scores. The evidence boundary is the official harness, API model versions, no-network Docker setting, VLM checklist judge, and absence of reported confidence intervals.

可信证据是一个公开、难度很高的 workflow-level benchmark，以及现有模型在其上的低 accuracy。论文报告 321 个任务平均有 11.8 个 worksheet、429.0 个 instruction words 和 593.5 个 modified cells；Financial Modeling 平均 15.3 sheets / 1,164.5 modified cells，Debugging 平均 21.1 sheets。

主结果中最高的 Claude Opus 4.6 overall Accuracy 为 34.89%，overall Modification 为 77.20%，但 Debugging Accuracy 只有 12.00%。其他 overall Accuracy 包括 GPT-5.2 26.79%、Gemini 3.1 Pro 23.68%、GLM-5 17.14%、Deepseek-V3.2 15.58%、Kimi K2.5 14.64%、Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 11.22%、MiniMax M2.5 7.17%。GLM-5 scaffold 对比中，作者的 SWE-agent-based scaffold 为 46.32 Modification / 15.45 Accuracy，Claude Code 为 43.47 / 14.20。Spreadsheet products 只在 30-example subset 上评测，不能当成全量 benchmark 分数。证据边界包括官方 harness、API 模型版本、无网络 Docker 设置、VLM checklist judge，以及没有报告置信区间。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior-work baseline is SpreadsheetBench 2024 and other office-agent benchmarks that emphasize individual spreadsheet manipulation or general app control. SpreadsheetBench 2 changes the unit of evaluation from a short spreadsheet operation to a business workflow with many dependent cells, multi-sheet inspection, domain assumptions, and task-level consistency.

The direction signal is the move from checked ranges in manipulation tasks to end-to-end workbook deliverables. The quality signal is the expert-built gold workbooks, four business categories, independent expert validation, public code/data artifacts, and explicit scaffold. What is not new is spreadsheet editing, exact workbook comparison, or agent scaffolding itself. Before reuse, inspect the raw-source licensing boundary, dataset/evaluation-code license conflict, hidden or absent split policy, VLM checklist dependence, Windows-only visualization export path, model API versions, and whether public tasks can contaminate training.

既有基线是 SpreadsheetBench 2024 和其他强调单个 spreadsheet 操作或通用 app control 的办公 agent benchmark。SpreadsheetBench 2 改变的是评测单位：从短 spreadsheet 操作变成业务 deliverable，要求多 sheet 检查、领域假设、许多依赖 cell 和任务级一致性。

方向信号是从 checked range manipulation 走向 end-to-end workbook deliverable。质量信号包括专家构造的 gold workbook、四类业务任务、独立专家验证、公开代码/数据 artifact 和显式 scaffold。不是新的部分包括 spreadsheet 编辑、exact workbook comparison 和 agent scaffolding。复用前必须检查 raw-source licensing boundary、dataset/evaluation-code license 冲突、split policy 缺失或隐藏、VLM checklist 依赖、Windows-only visualization export、模型 API 版本，以及公开任务是否会污染训练。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Correctness is relative to the gold workbook, selected target cells, preservation rules, and visualization checklist. Passing Modification does not necessarily mean a full business workbook is semantically sound, and failing one cell can make task-level Accuracy harsh even when much of the workflow was completed.

Several assumptions affect reuse. The paper says the dataset is CC BY-SA 4.0 and evaluation code is MIT, while Hugging Face metadata reports MIT, so the artifact-level license needs verification. The sources used to build tasks are public business and financial materials, but raw source documents are not fully redistributed. Visualization scoring depends on chart export through Excel/WPS COM and a GLM-4.6V judge. API model versions, scaffold implementation, turn budget, no-network Docker setup, spreadsheet engine, and absence of a confirmed train/dev/test split all limit comparability.

正确性只相对于 gold workbook、目标 cell、preservation rule 和 visualization checklist 成立。Modification 通过不等于整个业务 workbook 语义完全可靠；反过来，task-level Accuracy 很严，一个关键 cell 错误就可能让整题失败。

复用有多个隐藏假设。论文附录称 dataset 为 CC BY-SA 4.0、evaluation code 为 MIT，但 Hugging Face metadata 显示 MIT，因此 artifact-level license 需要核验。任务来源是公开业务/金融材料，但 raw source documents 并未完整再分发。Visualization 评分依赖 Excel/WPS COM 导出和 GLM-4.6V judge。API 模型版本、scaffold 实现、turn budget、无网络 Docker、spreadsheet 引擎，以及未确认 train/dev/test split 都会影响可比性。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use SpreadsheetBench 2 as a high-friction evaluation surface for spreadsheet agents that must inspect workbooks, reason over business structure, edit many cells, and preserve file consistency across a long episode. It is also useful as a schema reference for environment tasks: category, instruction, input workbook, gold workbook, modified-cell target set, preserved-cell checks, action/tool transcript, turn budget, and final score.

For atlas use, keep Modification separate from Accuracy, and keep workbook-comparison tasks separate from Visualization checklist tasks. This benchmark can inform verifier design, business workflow evaluation, and file-state agent audits. Turning it into a reward source or training set requires license resolution, contamination controls, and careful separation of public benchmark instances from hidden evaluation.

可以把 SpreadsheetBench 2 当作高摩擦办公 agent 评测面：agent 必须检查 workbook、理解业务结构、修改大量 cell，并在长 episode 后保持文件一致。它也提供了环境任务 schema：category、instruction、input workbook、gold workbook、modified-cell target set、preserved-cell checks、action/tool transcript、turn budget 和 final score。

在 atlas 里使用时，要把 Modification 和 Accuracy 分开，也要把 workbook-comparison 任务和 Visualization checklist 任务分开。它适合支持 verifier design、business workflow evaluation 和 file-state agent audit。若要转为 reward source 或训练集，必须先解决 license、污染控制和公开 benchmark/隐藏评测的隔离问题。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
Do not read SpreadsheetBench 2 as simply "SpreadsheetBench but larger." The main change is the task unit: a business deliverable with many linked cells and workflow-level consistency. Modification and Accuracy answer different questions, and Visualization uses a different judge from workbook comparison.

Read the task-category definitions, evaluator, and scaffold before comparing model names. The strongest claim is not that one frontier model wins; it is that even strong agents often make partial workbook progress without completing the end-to-end business task.

不要把 SpreadsheetBench 2 简单理解成“更大的 SpreadsheetBench”。主要变化是任务单位：它要求交付一个有大量 linked cells 和 workflow-level consistency 的业务结果。Modification 与 Accuracy 回答的是不同问题，Visualization 也不是 workbook comparison evaluator。

比较模型名次前，先读任务类别、evaluator 和 scaffold。最重要的结论不是某个 frontier model 领先，而是强模型也经常只能完成部分 workbook 修改，无法稳定完成端到端业务任务。
